_comment: The New Game intro (scenes/ui/IntroSequence.tscn, scripts/ui/intro_sequence.gd; Raphael 2026-11-07: a 'power point' introduction that plays while the world map loads). Every new run passes through it (GameManager.NEW_RUN_SCENE), then the world map (GameManager.WORLD_MAP_SCENE) shows the place the letter marked. Every word is DRAFT: plain modern speech, and canon kept (narrative-design.md: nothing named, nothing explained; the Priors, the pillar and the seal stay mysteries; the player has no face). illustration: the slide's art (placeholders from tools/ui/make_placeholder_intro.py; the inked art replaces them at the same path). A slide holds hold_seconds once its line is written out; the player can always go on early (click, Space, Enter, Right; a press while the line is still writing finishes it) or hold Esc / press Skip to leave. The arrival in the hall (the tavern, the pillar, the stranger) is Story 10.1's run-start panel, not part of this.

slides.text: Before the kingdoms, someone built in stone that doesn't weather. No one living can read what they carved. People call them the Priors.
Their pillars became furniture. People built houses and taverns around them, and stopped asking why they glow.
You were an adventurer once. You went into the dark more times than most, and came back. Then one day you stopped going.
The letter was short and unsigned. A tavern was yours now, and the guild that came with it, such as it was. The guild had no name.
On the road, people talked about villages past the border that had stopped sending letters. It hadn't reached here. Not yet.
A map came with the letter. One place on it was marked.
